data.title: Backup & data
data.intro: All your data is stored on this device only. Export it regularly to keep a copy.
data.exportDesc: Creates a JSON file with your habits, history, tasks, reminders and achievements.
data.importDesc: Replaces all current data with the content of a HabitFlow backup file.
data.importConfirmBody: This backup from {{date}} contains {{habits}} habits, {{logs}} check-ins and {{tasks}} tasks. Your current data will be replaced. This cannot be undone.
data.importInvalid: This file is not a valid HabitFlow backup.
data.importWrongApp: This backup comes from another app.
data.importNewer: This backup was made with a newer version of HabitFlow. Update the app first.
data.importFailed: The backup could not be restored. Your data was not changed.
data.deleteDesc: Erases habits, history, tasks, reminders and settings from this device. Purchases are kept by Google Play.
data.deleteConfirmBody: All your HabitFlow data will be permanently erased from this device. This cannot be undone.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: HabitFlow is designed to keep your personal data on your phone.
privacy.storageBody: Habits, check-ins, notes, tasks and reminders are stored only on this device. There is no HabitFlow server.
privacy.accountBody: HabitFlow works without an account, email address or sign-in.
privacy.notificationsBody: Reminders are scheduled locally by your phone. No push service is used.
privacy.analyticsBody: Only if you turn it on: anonymous usage events (e.g. "a habit was created"), never names, notes or your daily details.
privacy.adsBody: The free version shows a few ads served by Google AdMob, with your consent where required. Premium removes them.
privacy.purchasesBody: Purchases are processed by Google Play. HabitFlow only receives your Premium status.
privacy.rightsBody: Export or delete all your data at any time from Settings > Backup & data.
